}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== The '''Network Everywhere''' logo, the above tagline, "Model No.: NC100", "A/N: PCB-E540-MA3", and "P/N: E540 Rev. A" is silkscreened on the top of the card. :All the radial capacitors on this particular board are '''STONE''' branded.
The '''[[Network Everywhere]]''' labeled Ethernet controller (NC100, C994031DBX) would simply seem to be a relabeled '''[[Macronix]]''' chip.
